rotp_khnum.configuration.title: RotP Khnum Configuration
rotp_khnum.configuration.disguise.toolti: Which entities Entity Disguise may turn its user into.
rotp_khnum.configuration.minimumEntityHe: Entities shorter than this many blocks cannot be chosen for Entity Disguise.
rotp_khnum.configuration.maximumEntityHe: Entities taller than this many blocks cannot be chosen for Entity Disguise.
rotp_khnum.configuration.minimumEntityWi: Entities narrower than this many blocks cannot be chosen for Entity Disguise.
rotp_khnum.configuration.maximumEntityWi: Entities wider than this many blocks cannot be chosen for Entity Disguise.
rotp_khnum.configuration.entityBlacklist: Entity ids (resource location format, for example minecraft:arrow) that can never be chosen for Entity Disguise.
